verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack describes any data export feature, open-format export of call logs/transcripts/memories/pathways, or account data portability for leaving the platform. The docs cover pathways, calls, MCP/CLI integrations, and enterprise infra, but nothing about exporting user data. Missing for 10: any documented export/download feature, open format (CSV/JSON) data dumps, or account data portability guarantees.
